title: should surface the server's own message on the source picker when the source load fails
verifies: a failed eligible-alerts load with a server message shows that message on the source picker

title: should fall back to the generic message when the source load fails without a reason
verifies: a failed eligible-alerts load with no server message falls back to the generic copy

title: should hide the empty-state banner while a source load error is showing
verifies: the no-eligible-alerts info banner is not rendered while the picker is showing a load error
